mapper.select:
select id, name, type, lat, lng, radius_m, address, description, xp, coupon_template_id, city_code, status, audit_status, application_type, applicant_merchant_id, audit_reason, create_time, merchant_id, template_id, node_level, tags, cover_img, sort, (select n.avatar from npc_profile n where n.scope_type = 2 and n.scope_id = p.merchant_id and n.enabled = 1 and n.audit_status = 1 and n.del_flag = '0' order by n.sort asc, n.id asc limit 1) as npc_avatar,
(exists (select 1 from roam_poi_found f where f.poi_id = p.id and f.member_id = #{memberId}) or exists (select 1 from roam_poi_reward_log r where r.poi_id = p.id and r.member_id = #{memberId} and r.status in (0, 1))) as found,
(exists (select 1 from roam_poi_reward_log r where r.poi_id = p.id and r.member_id = #{memberId} and r.status = 0 and r.coupon_id > 0)) as pending_redeem from roam_poi p where p.status = 1 and (p.application_type is null or p.application_type = 2 or (p.application_type in (1, 3) and p.audit_status = 1)) and p.lat between #{minLat} and #{maxLat} and p.lng between #{minLng} and #{maxLng}
and (p.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or exists (select 1 from mms_merchant km where km.id = p.merchant_id and km.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')))
and exists (select 1 from mms_merchant cm where cm.id = p.merchant_id and (cm.category_id = #{categoryId} or find_in_set(#{categoryId}, cm.category_ids)))
and p.tags like concat('%', #{tag}, '%')
order by power(p.lat - (#{minLat} + #{maxLat}) / 2, 2) + power((p.lng - (#{minLng} + #{maxLng}) / 2) * cos(radians((#{minLat} + #{maxLat}) / 2)), 2) asc, p.id asc limit #{limit}

select distinct f.geohash7 from roam_fog_tile f join roam_session s on s.id = f.session_id and s.member_id = f.member_id where f.member_id = #{memberId} and f.geohash7 is not null and (s.status = 0 or (s.status = 1 and s.finished_at > date_sub(now(), interval 30 day))) and left(f.geohash7, 5) in #{p} order by f.geohash7 limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update roam_poi set name = #{name} where id = #{id}
